entities.name: Plutonium Management and Disposition Agreement
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: The Plutonium Management and Disposition Agreement is an agreement between the United States and Russia signed in 2000, wherein both nations agreed to dispose of significant fractions of their "excess" weapons-grade plutonium. An amended version was signed in April 2010 and went into effect in July 2011.
